packageRules.description: Ignore the locally built Bitcoin Core verification image
One weekly PR for non-major devDependency updates instead of one full CI run per package. Funds-critical packages are excluded here; they stay behind dashboard approval below.
One weekly PR for non-major type-definition updates, wherever they are declared.

Root overrides pin transitive packages exactly, and tests/ci/npmOverridesApplied.test.ts requires every lockfile copy to match. Renovate's own lockfile update drops the overridden package's lock entry instead of moving it (#1334, #1361, #1364). The post-upgrade task repairs that: it restores the base lockfile and lets npm move every copy to the new pin, the same steps as the hand bump in #1368 (the commands must stay inside allowedCommands in security-monitoring-infra/config/renovate.cjs). Updates stay behind dashboard approval until the first repaired PR has passed CI.

Funds-critical packages pinned in config/ci-toolchain-lock.json (fundsCriticalPackages): a Renovate PR can never pass scripts/ci/check-supply-chain-locks.mjs because the exact version and integrity must move together across every listed manifest and lockfile. List them on the dashboard instead of opening an unmergeable PR; bump them with scripts/bump-funds-critical.sh <package> <version> (see "Bumping a funds-critical package" in docs/reference/ci-cd-strategy.md), then approve the dashboard entry so Renovate can pick up the reviewed version.
